description: Type A — modèles avec enum status, champ Boolean isPaid, et relations FK. Cas représentatif : freelance-tracker (Client → Project → Invoice).
models: Client { id String @id @default(uuid()), name String, email String?, company String?, userId String, projects Project[], createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }

Project { id String @id @default(uuid()), title String, description String?, status ProjectStatus @default(proposal), isPaid Boolean @default(false), clientId String, client Client @relation(fields: [clientId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade), userId String, invoices Invoice[], createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }

Invoice { id String @id @default(uuid()), referenceNumber String, amount String, dueDate DateTime?, isPaid Boolean @default(false), projectId String, project Project @relation(fields: [projectId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade), userId String, createdAt DateTime @default(now()), updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt }
